objective: Standard statement: for the twelve classes of ticket A, prove that the normalized state sums N = c (lambda^3/mu)^V lambda^(-T) are, for the seven counting classes, 1, 1, 2, |H^1(M; Z/2)|/2, |H^1|/2, |H^1| and 1, and for the twisted classes D(M)/2 (even or odd cocycles) and |H^1|/2 + D(M)/2 or D(M) (the mixed classes on even-or-odd), where D(M) is the sum over a in H^1(M; Z/2) of (-1)^<a^3, [M]>; that a -> a^3 is linear on a closed orientable three-manifold (Wu's formula), so D(M) is |H^1| or 0 according as the cubic form vanishes; that D(M) = 0 exactly when some element t of order 2 in H_1 that is a Bockstein image has linking number lk(t, t) = 1/2 (for cyclic H_1 = Z/n with n even: exactly when n = 2 mod 4); and that D separates manifolds with the same first homology (H_1 = (Z/2)^2: values 0 and 4), checked on sampled triangulations. Nearest known result: Dijkgraaf-Witten invariants of lens spaces; cohomology rings of spherical space forms; linking forms. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by SIGNED-3D-20261029-001B-P001 (V1, classical background cited, 76 sampled triangulations): the twisted laws give D(M)/2 with D(M) the Gauss sum of the cubic form a -> a^3 on H^1(M; Z/2), which is linear (Wu), so D is |H^1| or 0, and D = 0 exactly when the linking form is 1/2 on an element of order 2 (cyclic H_1 = Z/n: n = 2 mod 4). D is not a function of homology (RP^3 # RP^3 versus S^3/Q_8; both values on sampled (Z/2)^2 triangulations), so signs and order see exactly one bit beyond |H^1(M; Z/2)|.
title: What the twist sees of a three-manifold
